text: `SPEC-v2.md` is marked `Draft v2.1` dated `2026-03-04`, supersedes `SPEC.md`, `MORE-SPECS.md`, and `QUICKSTART-draft.md`, and defines the core identities: OutcomeGraph as the canonical artifact model/storage layout, Steward as the always-on runtime loop, `og` as the stable CLI contract, and the worker adapter as a pluggable distillation/regeneration runtime whose first implementation is Codex.
